scope: Motion/H67 multiplier-free four-source FC2 signed-weight reduction and Acc24 update island

numeric_identity.rule: an active sn2 event contributes exactly one signed INT8 FC2 weight for the current checkpoint
numeric_identity.paft_requirement: keep every sn2 threshold exactly one or regenerate and validate a folded-weight quantization contract

arithmetic_order: two signed9 pair sums, one signed10 group sum, then one signed25 extended accumulator addition per output lane; truncate only after explicit signed24 overflow detection

m168_link.qualification: cycle boundary only; M169 does not include bank queues, compactor, weight SRAM response, BN2 or residual commit

fail_closed_exclusions: event bitmap to four distinct-bank source compaction and queue lifetime
four simultaneous 96-byte weight-row SRAM reads and response tags
complete token/context accumulator ownership and writeback
PAFT checkpoint and valid825 threshold/accuracy admission
FC2 final requantization, dynamic BN2 moment barrier and residual commit
macro-aware timing, power, energy, FPS, full FFN or system speedup
